study_type_evidence.quote: Bglap-/- male mice were injected intraperitoneally with 40 or 80 ng/g of body weight of mouse O-glycosylated ucOCN or non-glycosylated ucOCN
The mouse OCN ex vivo half-life assays were performed with fresh plasma (lithium heparin) collected from four independent Bglap-/- mice.
study_type_evidence.section: METHODS (Ex vivo half-life and plasmin enzymatic assays)

study_type_evidence.quote: INS-1 832/3 cells, a sub-clone of the INS-1 rat insulinoma cell line ... were treated with vehicle or low doses of non-glycosylated and glycosylated ucOCN
study_type_evidence.section: RESULTS (Impact of glycosylation on OCN activity in culture)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: male Bglap-/- (osteocalcin-deficient) mice, C57BL/6J background (backcrossed >10 times); age not reported
in_vivo_species.quote: Bglap-/- male mice were injected intraperitoneally with 40 or 80 ng/g of body weight

ex_vivo_detail: Plasma stability/half-life assays performed in freshly isolated lithium-heparin plasma from Bglap-/- (OCN-deficient) mice incubated at 37 C; classified ex vivo per protocol. Bone homogenates from C57BL/6J femur/tibia were also used for de-glycosylation and top-down MS analysis. Human ucOCN half-life was also measured ex vivo in Bglap-/- mouse plasma.
in_vitro_detail: Cell-culture work in HEK293 (wild-type, C1GALT1C1-/- COSMC-null, GALNT1/2/3/6 knockouts), CHO-K1 and CHO-ldlD cells, primary mouse calvarial osteoblasts, and INS-1 832/3 rat insulinoma cells; plus cell-free plasmin enzymatic assay in heat-inactivated diluted plasma.

agents.name: O-glycosylated mouse uncarboxylated osteocalcin (O-gly ucOCN)
agents.sequence_source: Full one-letter sequence of mature mouse OCN is shown only as Figure 1E graphic, not printed in body text; Discussion states only the partial motif 'SVPSPDP11' around the S8 O-glycosylation site.

agents.group_n: n = 5 mice (fasted in vivo experiment); n = 9 mice (fed in vivo experiment); n = 4 mice (fed, 40 or 80 ng/g, 2 h timepoint); n = 4 independent plasma per condition (ex vivo)
agents.group_n_quote: O-gly ucOCN (n = 5 mice) or ucOCN (n = 5 mice) were injected intraperitoneally at a dose of 40 ng/g of body weight

agents.dose_route_quote: injected intraperitoneally in OCN deficient male mice (Bglap-/-; n = 9 mice each) at a dose of 40 ng/g of body weight

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 3H (in vivo serum OCN vs time); Fig. 3I (% of maximum vs time); Fig. 3C and Fig. 5G (ex vivo % remaining vs time); Fig. 3—figure supplement 4A (in vivo, fed)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: O-gly ucOCN (n = 5 mice) or ucOCN (n = 5 mice) were injected intraperitoneally at a dose of 40 ng/g of body weight and serum OCN levels were measured at the indicated time points
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 3H plots serum OCN concentration versus time after a single i.p. dose in fasted Bglap-/- mice; Fig. 3C and 5G plot ex vivo plasma %-remaining versus time (0-5 h) for mouse and human ucOCN respectively.

bioanalytical_method: Sandwich ELISA for total mouse OCN (goat polyclonal anti-MID OCN capture, goat polyclonal anti-CTERM OCN detection) for mouse samples; commercial human ucOCN ELISA (BioLegend 446707, 8H4 capture / 4B6 detection) for human protein. Protein characterization by top-down RP-HPLC LC-MS and HCD MS/MS on Q Exactive / Orbitrap Fusion.
bioanalytical_quote: OCN level was measured at indicated time points using the total mouse OCN ELISA assay described previously
bioanalytical_section: METHODS (Ex vivo half-life and plasmin enzymatic assays; In vivo half-life assay)
notes: In vivo PK is limited to serum OCN-vs-time curves after single i.p. injection of recombinant mouse ucOCN in OCN-deficient (Bglap-/-) mice; half-lives (~182 min glycosylated, ~108 min non-glycosylated) were estimated from the declining phase of those curves, no formal non-compartmental PK parameters (AUC, clearance, Vd) are reported. Cmax not reported numerically; tmax inferred only from the statement that maxima occurred at 30 min. Human ucOCN was tested ex vivo in mouse plasma only, never administered to humans or animals, so there is no clinical arm. Plasmin (0-0.3 U/ml), talabostat, PMSF, EDTA, pepstatin A and Dec-RVKR-CMK were used as ex vivo mechanistic treatments rather than administered test articles and are not listed as agents. Full amino-acid sequences appear only in figure graphics (Fig. 1E, Fig. 5A) and are not printed in the body text.
